note: Authored demo data. These people and their signals are written by hand, not extracted from the corpus, and carry origin=demo-seed so nothing reads as a quote from a stored page.

signals.text: Wrote a blog post setting out a two-year plan to consolidate shared service centres and automate the back office across four countries.
Posted that the group is hiring process-mining engineers for a new operations excellence team.
Named on the speaker list for a telecom operations summit in Vienna.
Announced a new automation centre of excellence and said the team will double within the year.
Argued that finance close should be automated end to end and said the company is evaluating partners for the process layer.
Spoke on a podcast about the difficulty of measuring automation returns.
Told a trade paper the insurer will automate claims handling and expects a quantified headcount reduction by next year.
Posted that the bank is piloting document processing automation in three markets and wants to hear from vendors.
Wrote that robotics has plateaued at the bank and the next step is process intelligence rather than more bots.
Gave a keynote saying the plants will be re-planned around automated quality inspection next year.
Announced a cost-reduction programme with a quantified headcount target and named back-office automation as the lever.
Shared a photograph from a store visit with no commentary on technology.
Wrote about removing manual planning steps across the breweries and said the next budget cycle will fund it.
Posted that the security operations centre is being rebuilt around automated triage and that she is hiring for it.
Said in an interview that the shared service centres will absorb more work before any new ones are opened.
Discussed shared services careers on a finance podcast.
Told a logistics conference that the network runs on documents and that the documents are the next thing to go.
Wrote that the company builds its own automation platforms and will keep that capability in-house rather than buy it.
